theorems_audited.item: Theorem 1: Voronoi Facet Boundary Step Discontinuity
theorems_audited.statement: lim_{eps -> 0+} ||phi(x0 + eps n) - phi(x0 - eps n)||_2 = ||g_i - g_j||_2 > 0
theorems_audited.notes: Verified from first principles. Proves non-existence of a global continuous derivative across Voronoi facets on S^(D-1).

theorems_audited.item: Proposition 1: ArcFace Target Angular Separation Margin
theorems_audited.statement: Under target class separation theta_ij >= 2m with margin m = 0.5 rad, ||g_i - g_j||_2 >= 2 sin(m) approx 0.9589
theorems_audited.notes: Must be framed as the target design separation invariant enforced by ArcFace loss, rather than an unconstrained universal neural network guarantee.

theorems_audited.item: Proposition 2: Composite Lipschitz Chain Rule & Domain Restriction
theorems_audited.notes: Domain restriction to certified manifold X_cert avoids Voronoi facet singularities; fail-closed quarantine on X_quar maps corrupted inputs to constant null state bot.
